artifacts.title: Bludit bruteforce bypass to auth RCE and sudo UID-1 root (Blunder)
artifacts.starting_access: unauthenticated web access to a Bludit CMS on an Ubuntu host
transferable_properties: always enumerate txt/php files, todo.txt reveals usernames
use CeWL to build a targeted wordlist instead of generic rockyou
check ALL application directories, credentials are often reused across versions
(ALL, !root) in sudoers is not safe on sudo < 1.8.28, use sudo -u#-1

hypotheses.statement: Bludit 3.9.2 is vulnerable to bruteforce bypass and RCE

selected_action.intent: enumerate the CMS and build a targeted wordlist with CeWL

selected_action.intent: run the bruteforce bypass with the CeWL wordlist

evidence.summary: obtained fergus:RolandDeschain via the X-Forwarded-For bruteforce bypass

selected_action.intent: run the 48568.py exploit to get a reverse shell

evidence.summary: got a reverse shell as www-data via the CVE-2019-16113 authenticated RCE

observations: sudo version vulnerable to CVE-2019-14287 UID wraparound
